# TutorHub Bangladesh — Full AI System Context & Specification

## 1. System Overview
TutorHub is an end-to-end tuition lifecycle SaaS and verified tutor network operating in Bangladesh. It bridges university students providing private tuition with guardians seeking trusted academic mentors for their children.

## 2. Core Entities & Concepts

### Tuition Cycle
In Bangladesh, private tuition is traditionally billed either by monthly fixed days (e.g. 12 classes / month) or weekly frequency (e.g. 3 days / week).
- Each class logged counts towards `dayCount` of the current cycle.
- Once completed, the tutor triggers cycle completion, which automatically generates a verified digital invoice/receipt.
- Guardians receive a secure, passwordless magic link to their student portal to approve milestone cycles.

### Marketplace (Tuition Board)
- Guardians post postings specifying:
  - Class/Grade (Class 1 through HSC, A-Levels, O-Levels)
  - Curriculum (Bangla Medium NCTB, English Version, Edexcel, Cambridge)
  - Subjects (e.g., Higher Math, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Accounting)
  - Location/Area (Dhanmondi, Uttara, Mirpur, Bashundhara, etc.)
  - Teaching Mode (In-Person Home Tutoring, Online Tutoring, Hybrid)
  - Schedule Basis (Days per week or Days per month)
  - Monthly Budget in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT)
  - Preferred Teacher Gender (Any, Female Only, Male Only)
- Verified university teachers apply with personalized pitch messages.
- Zero agency fees are charged to teachers or parents.

### Verification System
- Teachers undergo a multi-step background credential check:
  - University Student ID card upload
  - National ID (NID) or Birth Certificate document upload
  - Cloudinary-backed document pipeline
  - Admin verification badge granting verified status

## 3. SEO & Discoverability Highlights
- Schema.org Structured Data: `EducationalOrganization`, `JobPosting`, `Person` (Tutor)
- Server-side rendered pages with OpenGraph, Twitter Cards, Canonical URLs
- Multi-viewport accessibility with minimum 320px support
- AI-friendly robots.txt allowing OpenAI GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended

## 4. Security & Scalability Controls
- Transport Security: HSTS (Strict-Transport-Security) with preload
- XSS Prevention: Strict CSP, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
- Clickjacking Prevention: X-Frame-Options: DENY
- Rate Limiting: Tiered IP-based throttling across global, auth, and upload routes
- Connection Pool: Mongoose connection pooling configured with maxPoolSize=100
- Audit Trails: Immutable SessionLogs and CycleHistory records
